subject.title: feat: add publisher follow controls and discovery

question: Should ClawHub accept publisher-follow controls and discovery as a core product/API surface now, or wait until the base follow API stack is proven and accepted?
rationale: This is a new discovery and private user-preference feature, not a bug fix, and it depends on an open base API PR with auth-boundary and public-contract implications.

options.title: Land the base API first
options.body: Require the base publisher-follow API PR to clear proof, docs, and generated-artifact blockers, then rebase and review this UI/discovery slice.

options.title: Review the stack together
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally review the API, controls, and notification PRs as one feature stack while owning the private follow-state boundary together.

options.title: Pause this follow-up
options.body: If the base follow API direction is not accepted, pause or close this controls PR instead of carrying a conflicting stacked branch.

recommendation.title: Land the base API first
recommendation.body: Require the base publisher-follow API PR to clear proof, docs, and generated-artifact blockers, then rebase and review this UI/discovery slice.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main provenance for the API route, schema package, and public contract surfaces points to Patrick-Erichsen.
